_comment: Generated by tools/gen_live_cases.py. Do not edit by hand. Jarvis Live (owner, 2026-09-28; docs/LIVE-DESIGN.md): what the Live sign says, when an app may send the next clip and keep its microphone open (never while a card waits, never on a stale link, never while muted), what to do with the PC's reply, the fixed lines, the tap chips (never on a card), side talk (never spoken), interrupting (duck, then stop only for the owner), and that the camera switch shows only on the phone and only when the PC says it is ready.
title: Jarvis Live
link_lost_said: I've lost the link to your PC.
